title: Janïr yurir jaqinakan arsutapa
intro: Taqi chuyma almax janïr mä wawax purinkipanxa mä qullan arsüwi luratayna. Aka chimpun sarnaqäwipax mä santuario pirqanakanw uñsti, kawkhantix devoción ukax divin katuqawimp jikisi. ¿Khitis aka Allahan luqtiripaxa?
clues: Nayax Quran qillqatan jach’añchat mä familiankirïtwa.
Nayax mä jach’a juramento lurawayta, janïr yurki uka wawajaruw Allah-ar luqtañatak katuyañataki.
Nayajj wawachaskäyät ukhajja, mä yoqall wawanïñ suykchiyätsa, mä imill wawakïtap amuyasajj wal muspharta.
Wawajarojj Maryam sasaw sutichta, uka sutijj Diosar taqe chuyma servita ukat serviñ uñachtʼayi.
Nayax Allahan jark’aqasiñap thaqhawayta wawajataki ukhamarak wawanakapataki maldecido Supayan.
Wawajax Tatitun katuqatäna ukat Zakariya profetan uñjataparuw santuario ukan uchapxäna.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
